meta.description: Synthetic EV charger power data — sensor.ev_charger_power
meta.note: Synthetically generated fixture (not real device data). Statistics encode 9 overnight charging sessions (5-16h each). History is a partial excerpt: session 1 is dense (35s cadence) with a deliberate ~90s duty-cycle dip to exercise gap-bridging; sessions 5 and 9 are rendered at 10-min cadence for realism.
